newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Airlines sees Q4 lower than yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Airlines sees Q4 lower than yr ago.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said on Monday that it expect its earnings in the fourth quarter to be substantially below last year's levels.
In the fourth quarter of 1995, it reported earnings per share of $0.29 and net income of $43 million.
Revenue per available seat mile fell due to strong demand for leisure fares as well as increased trip lengths, chief executive officer Herbert Kelleher said in a statement.
"Based on these trends and significantly higher jet fuel prices, our fourth quarter 1996 earnings will be substantially below last year's record fourth quarter earnings," he said.
